snippet.title: Development Trailer #1 for Hamster Quest
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4012750/Hamster_Quest/

*Work in Progress*

A Cozy 2D platformer in a Small Open World, you play as a plucky hamster jumping out of a wooden barrel, navigating whimsical environments filled with hidden fruit, obstacles, water levels, and cheese.

Wishlist it on Steam !
